[USER] User introduced Area No 1: Data DAOs.  
[USER] The opportunity presented by Data DAOs involves the preservation, curation, augmentation, and promotion of high-value datasets.  
[USER] Examples of datasets include genomic databases, historical blockchain data, Wikipedia, NFT collections, and metaverse assets.  
[USER] Stake in Data DAOs can be tokenized, allowing for objective expression and transaction of data value in markets.  
[USER] Interested parties could earn tokens by analyzing datasets and performing scientific and ML modeling.  
[USER] Stakeholders could spend tokens to incentivize production of raw data, creating a circular data-centric economy.  
[USER] The potential of Data DAOs is enhanced by the FVM, which allows for composable layers to create different kinds of DAOs.
